description: This file defines the 'Counts' class which provides static methods for statistical counting functions such as COUNT, COUNTA, and COUNTBLANK, used within the PhpSpreadsheet library to perform various cell counting operations.

classes.name: Counts
classes.description: Provides static methods for counting cells based on various conditions such as numeric content, non-empty, and blank cells.

methods.name: COUNT
methods.description: Counts the number of cells containing numbers within the given arguments.

methods.name: COUNTA
methods.description: Counts the number of non-empty cells within the given arguments.

methods.name: COUNTBLANK
methods.description: Counts the number of empty cells within the provided range.
